title: KazByte: Adapting Qwen models to Kazakh via Byte-level Adapter
summary: Large language models fragment Kazakh text into many more tokens than equivalent English text, because their tokenizers were built for high-resource languages. This tokenizer tax inflates compute, shortens the effective context window, and weakens the model's grip on Kazakh morphology. We propose to bypass the tokenizer entirely by feeding raw bytes through a small adapter that learns to speak the internal language of a frozen Qwen2.5-7B.
